items.title: NHS Innovation Accelerator 2027 cohort closes in 6 days (2026-09-27) — application status still unconfirmed, no NHS deployment evidence found in repo
items.text:
*HIGH* — NHS Innovation Accelerator 2027 cohort closes in 6 days (2026-09-27 23:59), application status still unconfirmed
First flagged 2026-09-09 with an open question: does CardiTrack have NHS-side deployment or outcomes evidence to be competitive, given NIA funds *scaling* proven solutions, not early-stage product development. A repo-wide check today (docs/, research/, issues) found no NHS Trust pilot, deployment, or real-world-evidence record anywhere — so the fit condition from the original brief still isn't met, and there's no application-status tracking in this repo to confirm whether anyone applied anyway.
Smallest next action: whoever owns the NIA relationship needs to say, before 2026-09-27 23:59, either "submitted" (confirm it went in) or "not applying this cohort" (then the 2028 cycle is the next window) — six days is not enough runway to build an evidence base from nothing.
https://nhsaccelerator.com/about-the-nia-programme/apply-for-nia-fellowship/

claude "work through @research/queue/2026-09-21-nia-2027-deadline-six-days-no-status.md"
